dual_approval.comments: Approved unauthenticated-REST-endpoint golden finding for wordpress-security-recovery-hardening: permission_callback is hardcoded to '__return_true', so the customer PII endpoint is reachable by anyone with no authentication. The SQL query itself is correctly parameterized via $wpdb->prepare, so this fixture also verifies the auditor doesn't wrongly report SQL injection here instead of the real authorization gap.
